_comment: Shared run configuration for everything under eval/scale_results/. Kept as one sidecar (not per-file) because these values were constant across the whole scale-ladder session and the later re-verification pass -- see per-section notes below for what changed between them and when.

runs.label: original scale ladder (1k-57k) + citation-index fix
runs.notes: recall_hit fields in these files were patched post-hoc on 2026-07-15 (commit 4b50529 and the commit that added this file) to the strict rank<=5 definition -- see 'Recall@5 counting bug' in VALIDATION.md. rank/reciprocal_rank per case were always correct; only the recall_hit boolean was stale.

runs.label: re-verification pass: fixed run_eval.py, regenerated golden/heldout/cross_question (cross-reference multi-answer ground truth) and id_free (hard-negative date-uniqueness fix) datasets, re-run live end to end
runs.notes: these 4 files at the 57000 checkpoint were re-run live (not just recomputed) against the same corpus/config above after the dataset and script fixes; results matched the offline recomputation from the original run within normal run-to-run LLM variance (+/-1 case out of 150).

runs.label: citation-number generalization test (new)
runs.notes: new 50-case disjoint held-out set, built and run for the first time in this pass -- see eval/build_eu_citation_heldout_dataset.py and 'Citation-number generalization test' in eval/README.md.

concurrency_test.not_saved_to_json: concurrency_test.py does not write a results file -- these numbers are transcribed directly from its stdout, quoted in VALIDATION.md and eval/README.md.
